# `aitbc resource deallocate`

Release a resource allocation by its allocation ID.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc resource deallocate [OPTIONS] ALLOCATION_ID
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `allocation_id` | text | yes | — |

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--force` | flag | `false` | no | Deallocate without confirmation |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc resource deallocate ALLOCATION_ID
```
